<!-- pr-reviewer: 82c5cf13cef0658a909d23661aefaa4cc7667f80 -->
**Needs changes before merge.**

This review is under the safety floor (the stock sim can now block the post for a turned stock). I built and tested the PR locally, merged with `origin/main` at `1f15f98e7`. I did not use the self-hosted runner (maintainer order for this review).

### What looks good

- The frame of `stock_follow::sim_frame` is correct. A reviewer probe (not committed) turned a 40 x 10 x 6 box stock at pos (37, -12, 5) through all 64 combinations of quarter turns about X, Y and Z. For each turn, the world box of the twin is equal to the world box of the turned stock mesh (tolerance 1e-9). The same probe on an upright cylinder accepts 16 turns with a matching world box, and refuses the 48 laid turns with `LAID_CYLINDER`.
- `stock_grid` reads the true frame. The probe sets a 40 x 10 box stock turned +90 and -90 degrees about Z, on its side, and upside down. The lattice spans x 95..105 and y 30..70 for the +90 turn, which is the turned box and not the unturned one. The top is the true top in each case.
- An oblique turn is refused by name, never approximated. The probe gives `OBLIQUE_STOCK` for 30 degrees about Z, 30 degrees about X, 45 degrees, 1e-8 rad and a quarter turn plus 1e-7 rad. An upright cylinder spun 30 degrees about its own axis is also refused (conservative, and named).
- From-model stock now goes through the full transform (`transform_point` with `loc.rot` in `stock_grid`, `world_facets` in `first_body` / `first_field`). This is correct.
- The `MoveModel` rule (`crates/app/src/commands/move_model.rs:205`) keeps `before.rot` only when `turns()` says the part did not turn. The position still follows the move. The error is at the size of the solve noise.
- No golden `.nc` / `.cl` file and no snapshot PNG changes. No new `unwrap` / `expect` / `panic!` outside tests. New code reads the ECS world or is a command, so it is correctly in `app`. Clippy is clean.
- The four failures below show that the main claim is true: a quarter-turned stock is now judged, and the sim finds the gouge and blocks the post.

### Results (locally, trial merge with main `1f15f98e7`)

| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app` (lib + 56 suites from `gate quick --dry-run`) | lib 353 ok; **4 suites red, 9 tests**; all other suites ok |
| `stock_in_vise_sim` (new) | 2 / 2 ok |
| `stock_sim_document` 9, `stock_view` 4, `rotary_field_parity` 3, `posting` 17, `post_not_judged` 4, `verify` 21, `setup_carry*`, `stock_source_verdict` 22 | ok |
| `remachining::a_rotated_stock_refuses_rather_than_guessing` | ok |
| `camcraft-ui` lib (949) and 13 ui suites (from `crates/ui`) | ok |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | ok |
| Reviewer frame probe (3 tests, not committed) | ok |

Failures (all are "post blocked" - the post IS refused, but by the program sim, not by the operation's own verdict that the test pins):

```
engrave_law.rs:147  wall-Engrave-true: post blocked - gouge: program cuts below the model in 2215 cell(s), worst 4.00 mm at (-1.44, -17.94, z 3.70)
engrave_law.rs:147  deep-Engrave-true: post blocked - gouge: program cuts below the model in 5179 cell(s), worst 4.00 mm ...
engrave_law.rs:147  low-top-Engrave-true: post blocked - gouge: program cuts below the model in 5171 cell(s), worst 1.00 mm ...
mark_floor.rs:160   Engrave: post blocked - gouge: program cuts below the model in 3168 cell(s), worst 1.10 mm at (18.81, 17.31, z -0.90)
mark_floor.rs:253   Engrave: post blocked - gouge: program cuts below the model in 3168 cell(s), worst 1.10 mm ...
neighbour_law.rs:136 into-a-trace-true: post blocked - gouge: program cuts below the model in 642 cell(s), worst 0.30 mm at (-2.69, -19.94, z 7.70)
stock_source_law.rs:199 low-stock-face-true: post blocked - gouge: program cuts below the model in 6422 cell(s), worst 2.50 mm ...
stock_source_law.rs:199 slot-false-true: post blocked - gouge: program cuts below the model in 1344 cell(s), worst 3.00 mm ...
stock_source_law.rs:199 engrave-false-true: post blocked - gouge: program cuts below the model in 3168 cell(s), worst 4.00 mm ...
```

### Requested before merge

1. **Keep the coverage of "the sim does not judge, the operation's verdict alone blocks the post".** `engrave_law.rs`, `mark_floor.rs`, `neighbour_law.rs` (`job`, lines 65-75) and `stock_source_law.rs` use a stock turned a quarter about Z (`quat_from_yaw(FRAC_PI_2)`) as the device that makes the sim refuse. This PR makes the sim judge that stock, so the `by_op` / `rotated` checks fail (`engrave_law.rs:147`, `mark_floor.rs:160` and `:253`, `neighbour_law.rs:136`, `stock_source_law.rs:199`). Do not only delete the `by_op` checks: that loses the pin on the generator-time verdict when the sim is silent. Change the device to one the sim still refuses (for example an oblique stock turn that keeps the part inside the stock, or the refusal device that `post_not_judged.rs` uses), and keep the op-message assertions on it. You can keep the quarter turn as a second case that asserts the program-sim gouge now blocks. Also update the stale comments ("turned, nothing judged A", `neighbour_law.rs:8` and `:65-66`; "Turned, the op's own gouge is the only judge", `mark_floor.rs:157`). The `#[test]` count must stay the same or grow.
2. **Write the PR body.** It is empty. AGENTS.md "Done on a branch" requires: what changed, the readings, the pinning tests, what was not exercised, a `Changelog:` line, and the last line `Fixes #2177`. The commit body has `Fixes #2177`, but the PR body must have it too.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)

- Overlap with PR #2184: #2184 does not edit `move_model.rs`. `git merge-tree` of the two heads is clean. #2184 reaches this code through `LocatePart` -> `MoveModel::moved_stock` (`PartWrite::Move`), and its new `fixture_locate::stock_lands` compares the moved stock box with the planned carried box at `LEN_TOL_MM`. With this PR, a locate that does not turn the part keeps the stock's own turn; the difference to the rigid follow is solve noise (about 1e-13), far under `LEN_TOL_MM`. After the second of the two merges, run `fixture_locate_stock`, `fixture_locate_stock_body` and `stock_in_vise_sim` again. I did not run the combination.
- Gate effect, read from `posting_sim.rs`: before this PR, a turned stock gave "not judged", and an op without a fresh stamped verdict then blocked the post. Now the sim judges a square-turned stock; a clean sim verdict lets such a program post, as it does for an unturned stock. The probe shows that the judged volume is the true one, so I find no false "clean". The module text of `posting_sim.rs` (line 11, "a rotated stock") now reads "an oblique stock" in fact; you can update it.
- `crates/app/src/stock_sim.rs` is 469 lines (already over 400 before; this PR makes it 2 lines shorter).
- Existing projects that hold the solve noise are also fixed: `sim_frame` reads a turn within 1e-9 of square as square.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
